audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The fixed connection in the proposed deformation is not Yang-Mills; The tangential neck Ricci formula omits g''; Incorrect volume normalization and unnormalized Moser density
limitations: F01 — The fixed connection in the proposed deformation is not Yang-Mills — Counterevidence: The k=1 example has positive full Ricci matrix; nonzero mixed Ricci does not by itself force negativity. No impossibility of alternative paths or of the main theorem is claimed.

F02 — The tangential neck Ricci formula omits g'' — Counterevidence: This tests the asserted general formula, not the particular final neck. Slow reparametrization and a second derivative bound could repair an estimate; no verified replacement constants are claimed.

F03 — Incorrect volume normalization and unnormalized Moser density — Counterevidence: Use tensor exponent -1/3 and the volume form of the normalized tensor, or consistently square a length factor. This repairs the integration obstruction but not F01/F02.

F04 — Coprime weights alone do not imply freeness on S3 x R4 — Counterevidence: Actual construction uses (1,k), and is free. The generic nonzero-R4 locus has trivial stabilizer when weights are coprime.

F05 — Universal metric-cone claim conflicts with stated cylindrical blow-down — Counterevidence: Bounded-index subsequences avoid this particular limit; no geometric obstruction to the main inductive construction is established.

F06 — Orientation-reversing mapping classes are omitted — Counterevidence: Sigma is an isometry of the equal-sphere product. For orientation-reversing phi, psi=sigma o phi preserves orientation and psi*g0=phi*g0, so the intended path conclusion reduces to the orientation-preserving case.
Limitations: Focused verification of the six existing Problems only; no whole-paper re-review.
Limitations: No journal-final PDF comparison or assertion that the 2024/2025 text retains the v3 defects.
Limitations: No complete replacement proof after the three Major findings is certified.
Limitations: The outside mapping-class classification and all compactness dependencies were not reproved.
Limitations: Full acceptance/build/page gates and delivery state remain the parent agent's responsibility.

repair.content:
A different connection/path construction or controlled transition is needed; merely correcting the bracket index or b monotonicity does not fix the harmonic matching.

Bound both dot(gtilde) and ddot(gtilde), retain g''=ddot(gtilde)*(t')^2+dot(gtilde)*t'', and re-establish the simultaneous positivity bounds.

Correct normalization and density, then perform the equivariant weighted elliptic/Moser argument.

Require |a|=1 for this global product-model assertion.

Restrict the cone assertion and distinguish general pointed blow-down limits.

State the mapping-class structure for Diff+ and add the isometric swap reduction.
